answer: A mountain ranger station keeps one agent honest with one summit vertex. Each season the agent climbs to its cairn, sets a crystal marker stone on top, and plants one kernel in each of ten marked squares in the plot below. The ranger counts the sprouts each autumn and writes the count beside the key. A second key claiming the same cairn voids both, and a season with no sprouts strikes the name. A thousand fake names need a thousand climbed summits, a thousand crystal markers, and ten thousand planted kernels.
